summary: Backend-only testing of FreshCuts FastAPI. Wrote 24 pytest cases across health, products (list/filter/get/404), pincode check (serviceable & non-serviceable), auth (register/login/me/duplicate/wrong-pw/no-token), orders (auth-required, bad-pincode, create + GET verify persistence, list-my-orders), admin authorization (403 for normal user, 401 for anon), admin CRUD (create+delete product with GET verification, create+delete pincode with duplicate + serviceability check), and Stripe checkout. 23/24 passed (95.8%). Only failure: /api/payments/checkout returns 500 because STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent is a placeholder, not a valid Stripe test key -- Stripe rejects it with 'Invalid API Key provided'. All other 12 requested test scenarios pass end-to-end including full order creation flow, admin RBAC, and seeded data verification (22 products, pincode 560001 serviceable, 999999 not).

critical.issue: Returns 500 'Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent'. The env value STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent in /app/backend/.env is a placeholder string, not a real Stripe test secret key. Main agent must either (a) obtain a real Stripe test key from user (sk_test_XXXX...) or (b) switch to emergentintegrations' payment integration (emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout), which supports the sk_test_emergent placeholder as documented in Emergent's Stripe playbook.

action_items: Fix Stripe integration: replace raw `stripe` SDK usage in /app/backend/server.py (lines 9, 29, 316-374) with `emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout` so the placeholder sk_test_emergent key works out-of-the-box, OR ask the user for a real Stripe test secret key and update /app/backend/.env accordingly.
Consider updating /app/memory/test_credentials.md to include the seeded admin credentials (admin@freshcuts.com / Admin@123) so future testing agents don't have to guess.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') - should migrate to lifespan context manager (not blocking, but deprecated in FastAPI >=0.109).

server.py:25 sets a default value 'sk_test_emergent' for STRIPE_API_KEY which is invalid at Stripe; either enforce it via os.environ[...] like other secrets or migrate to emergentintegrations wrapper.

server.py:79 - the Literal for cut_type omits 'julienne' from SEED_PRODUCTS but includes it in the allowed values (fine), however 'batonnet' etc are enumerated - acceptable but consider using an Enum for maintainability.
server.py is 458 lines - still under 700 threshold but approaching; consider splitting into routers (auth, products, pincodes, orders, payments) for future maintainability.

Order creation does not decrement product stock nor validate against current price/stock; a user could send arbitrary price in items[].price. Consider server-side revalidation from db.products before persisting.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed created; relied on startup seeder (22 products, 8 pincodes, admin user). Test users are auto-created per session with TEST_ prefix and freshcuts-test.com domain; test-created products/pincodes are cleaned up in the same tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL comes from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs like .test/.example -- use real-looking domains for register tests. All 12 originally requested scenarios pass except Stripe checkout, which needs either a real test key or emergentintegrations. Admin credentials: admin@freshcuts.com / Admin@123. After main agent fixes Stripe, only re-run TestStripeCheckout.
rca_of_issue: Stripe checkout 500: /app/backend/server.py:25 sets STRIPE_API_KEY default to 'sk_test_emergent' and /app/backend/.env also has STRIPE_API_KEY="sk_test_emergent". The `stripe` Python SDK forwards this string to api.stripe.com which returns 401 -> our handler converts to 500 with body 'Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****gent'. Reproduction: POST /api/payments/checkout with any valid order_id and user token -> 500. Mitigation: use emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout (which is designed to work with sk_test_emergent) OR provide a real Stripe test key. See action items.
